name: Curtains and blinds
summary: How expats order curtains and blinds in Singapore — blackout for shift work, motorised options, condo railing rules, and humidity-safe fabrics.
body:
Curtain and blinds shops measure, sew, and install window treatments for HDB and condo bays. Blackout and dual-layer setups matter for shift workers and nursery rooms; motorised tracks help high windows.

## Decision points
- Blackout vs sheer vs dual-layer stacks
- Roller / venetian / cellular blinds trade-offs
- Motorised tracks and smart-home pairing
- Landlord-safe installs vs drilling limits
- Fabric choices that handle humidity and mould risk

Always confirm railing and facade rules with MCST when relevant.

## How to choose
Prefer shops that do on-site measuring and include installation in the quote. Ask about warranty on motors and child-safe cords. Request leftover fabric for future repairs.

## Practical tip
Measure twice for bay windows and AC ledge gaps. Most remakes come from skipped ledge depths, not fabric colour regrets.
